estimates.assumptions: Standard small dried shrimp: 2 tbsp volume ≈ 16g based on typical density of small dried shrimp (about 8g per tbsp).
1 medium napa cabbage head (edible portion after discarding core) is typically 700-900g; 800g used here as realistic average for a full head.
Standard: 1 tbsp peanut oil = 14g, so 2 tbsp = 28g.
4 chopped scallions ≈ 60g total (average 15g per medium scallion including green and white parts).
1 tsp kosher salt ≈ 5g (standard density for kosher salt).
1/2 tsp ground pepper ≈ 1g (standard density for black pepper).
